text: Deep in a canyon, you find the tomb of a sword saint. Ten thousand rusted blades stand around it like a forest.

choices.label: Draw the blade at the heart of the tomb

outcomes.text: Every sword in the tomb sings as the saint's own blade answers you.
The blades turn on the intruder.

choices.label: Sit among the swords and read their intent

outcomes.text: Days later, man and blade feel like one. You rise knowing the Sword Dao of Unity.
The intent is too heavy to follow, but you leave wiser.

text: On a burning peak, a great nest of embers glows. Its owner is nowhere to be seen.

outcomes.text: The flames burn the weakness from you and write a technique on your bones.
The heat is too much. You retreat, singed.

choices.label: Take a fallen feather and leave

outcomes.text: A single feather, warm as a heartbeat.

text: Behind a sealed door in an ancient library lies a text bound in black ink that seems to move when you look away.

outcomes.text: The scripture drowns you in understanding and gives it back as something you can use.
The words rewrite something in your mind. You tear yourself away, bleeding from the eyes.
It screams as it burns. The library is a little safer for it.

text: A hermit offers you a trial of the heart: face your deepest regret and see whether your dao holds.

outcomes.text: You face it, and the regret loosens its grip. The hermit gives you a ring of polished heartwood.
The regret wins this time. You leave quiet and shaken.
Some wounds are best left alone.

text: Behind a waterfall, a pool of thick, glowing liquid pulses with the marrow of the earth.

outcomes.text: You collect a few drops, which condense into a pill.
The pool stirs and drives you off.
A deep, healing warmth sinks into you.

text: A pond that blooms only for pure hearts opens before you, with a single white lotus at its center.

outcomes.text: It comes away in your hand. You feel your past burdens grow lighter.
The lotus sheds a petal at your feet as you leave.

text: A rain of stars falls across the night sky, and one of them lands in the field beside you, still glowing.

outcomes.text: It cools into silvery cloth that wraps around your shoulders like a promise.
It is far hotter than it looks.

choices.label: Draw its energy from a distance

outcomes.text: A steady stream of star-qi.

text: A hermit living above the clouds says he has waited all his life for someone to ask him a good question.

choices.label: Ask about the nature of the Dao

outcomes.text: He answers with a riddle that takes you a year to understand. Then he smiles and presses a pill into your palm.
He answers with a riddle you do not understand.

choices.label: Ask for the secret of a long life

outcomes.text: 'Do not fear death,' he says, and gives you an elixir.
'Do not fear death,' he says, and nothing more.
